newsitem.title: USA: Casa Ole says plans to buy Monterey's.
newsitem.headline: Casa Ole says plans to buy Monterey's.

text.p: Casa Ole Restaurants Inc said Friday it has entered into a non-binding letter of intent with Monterey's Acquisition Corp to buy its stock for about $11 million.
The company said the $11 million deal would be comprised of a combination of cash and an assumption of debt.

The company also said it expects to miss earnings per share estimates for the first quarter by a few cents because of the slower than expected pace of new restaurant development, and some new unit sales shortfalls.
The company was not immediately able to provide information about what these first quareter estimates are.
The company said earnings for its first quarter, which ended April 18, will be released around May 20.
The company said Monterey's Acquisition Corp owns and operates 26 Mexican restaurants in Texas and Oklahoma principally under the names Monterey's Tex-Mex Cafe(R" and Monterey's Little Mexico.
Casa Ole operates or franchises 47 Mexican restaurants, primarily in Texas and Louisiana.
